name: (02) Dementation — 3 Advanced — Mind of a Killer

system.description: This power allows you to alter the mind of your target, making her a cold-blooded killer. The first person to offend the target in any way becomes her chosen victim, and the target does everything in her power to kill that victim. So strong is the hatred that in the presence of her victim she must win a Static Mental Challenge every 10 minutes or frenzy and attack. Once the task is completed, the effect ends and the target is left to agonize over her deed, unaware of what provoked her (a Beast Trait/Path check may be in order). This power works on supernatural creatures and mortals, requires you to kiss the victim (a Physical Challenge may be in order) and defeat her in a Mental Test. Willpower may not be used to negate the effects of this power. This power lasts one night per Mental Trait invested into the initial challenge, or until the death of the target's victim.
system.duration: One night per Mental Trait invested
